svg.aria-label: Sequence of messages in the 90-second demo: the driver phone detects the crash and sends an SMS through the gateway phone to the server, which scores it and shows a pin to the dispatcher; a witness report merges into it; the dispatcher decides, sends a pre-alert to the hospital, the hospital acknowledges, and the driver sees received.
svg.title: Hero flow: from impact to a ready hospital
